audio.mode: AAC 256k encoded once from original MP3 for portable MP4 playback

waveform_check.note: Normalized cross-correlation, +/-100 ms lag search; technical alignment, not listening.

motion_accounting.note: New generation, reused existing source frames, supplied drawn-exposure sequences, first-frame holds, endpoint holds and still-camera frames are separate. Drawn-exposure duration measures the sequence, not continuous body motion or phoneme-complete sync. Source approval is not sequence approval.

visual_scope: Opening chronological fade frames/native branding crop; S014 first/middle/last whole frames and native-resolution crown sample. These cache frames were matched by decoded full-frame SHA256 to the final complete MP4. Not a new whole-film or all-frame motion review.
